note: NECO Financial Accounting Paper III round 1: the SSCE syllabus - nature and purpose, the accounting equation (with calculations), double entry and ledgers, books of prime entry, trial balance, final accounts (gross/net profit calculations), adjustments (straight-line depreciation machine-verified, accruals, bad debts), bank reconciliation, control accounts, manufacturing accounts, non-profit accounts, and errors/suspense. Near-dup scanned against the JAMB, WAEC and existing NECO banks.
